Collected hard biscuits (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'I have been assembling armour for the guards of this city for what seems like days, and I have developed an appetite! I don't have time to prepare dinner. If you can bring me something, I'll give you some coins and materials for the favour!
'I don't want just anything, though. Bring me some roast pork and two hard biscuits.
'Actually, make that two servings of roast pork! Just one won't be enough to keep me going!'
'This food looks delicious, ${PLAYER}! Thank you very much, and here is your payment!'
'I'm hungry! Where are my two servings of roast pork and my hard biscuits?'
Bring roast pork and hard biscuits to Ingi Steambeard
Collect roast pork (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Collect hard biscuits (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Steambeard's Hungry Work
Ingi Steambeard has been hard at work fashioning armour for the dwarves that defend Gondamon, and now he is ready to eat.
'Thank you for the meal!'
'All this work makes me hungry!'

Ingi Steambeard is at Gondamon, in the Low-lands of Ered Luin.
Ingi Steambeard is hungry and wants you to bring him two servings of roast pork and two hard biscuits with which to feed his appetite.
Defeated hendrevail (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
The lynx-cub emerges from its den

'What happened to me? I was out hunting bear, and I came across this mother lynx and her cubs. The poor thing was tore up mightily by some hendrevail, and I was just able to grab her before they went after me. I twisted my ankle something terrible but it'll heal, as will this old she-cat.
'She left a litter behind her, but we're both too battered to save the cubs ourselves. I'd feel awful if something happened to them but I'm no use to anyone until my ankle mends.
'Perhaps you can venture up to the den by the standing stones to the north and bring back any of the surviving cubs? I'd appreciate it, and I'm sure the mother would as well.'

You peer inside the abandoned bear-den and hear the plaintive mewing of a hungry, frightened lynx-cub.
The poor thing is scared to leave the safety of the den, fearing attack by hendrevail.
With soothing words, you manage to coax the frightened cub from the safety of its den.

'There's a precious cub! Let me take him from you and...ooww! Quit your scratching! He's a feisty one, isn't he? Or is it a she?
'Poor little thing. Too bad its litter-mates didn't fare so well, but that's the way of things. Hmmm...nipping my beard now. Perhaps the wee thing is hungry?'
'Lynx raise their young in dens or small burrows, especially those abandoned by other animals.'
Search the abandoned bear den
Defeat hendrevail (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Coax the lynx-cub from its den
Bring the lynx-cub to Thrasi
The Cat's Meow
Thrasi, a dwarf hunter, rescued a mother lynx while out hunting bears. He was attacked by a flock of hendrevail and had to leave the mother's cubs behind.
'It's not far from here. Walk north to the old standing stones. The den is in the side of a hill.'
'Look at those paws! This one is going to be a fearsome hunter when its reaches full size.'
'Hahaha... it's lickin' me face!'
'Good to see a mother and child reunited, even if they're of the four-legged variety.'

The abandoned den should be north of the hunter's lodge near the standing stones.
Thrasi hurt his leg while rescuing an injured lynx from hendrevail and asked you to retrieve the surviving cubs.

There are hendrevail throughout the woods.
A frightened lynx-cub cowers in an old den, too scared to venture out into the light. You must defeat the hendrevail lurking nearby to prove that you mean it no harm.

Coax the lynx-cub from its den.
With the hendrevail defeated, the lynx-cub seems to feel safe enough to leave its den.

Thrasi is back at the hunter's lodge, south of here.
You recovered the lynx-cub as Thrasi requested. Return it to him at the hunter's lodge.
You collect the rabbit from the trap
The trap is empty
Collected a rabbit carcass

'The cub is hungry, but he is too young to hunt his own food. His mother is still all scratched up and in no position to hunt either. Let's see...the only meat I have here at the lodge is either dried or smoked. I think they both could use some fresh, raw meat.
'Could I ask you for another favour? I wonder if you can find a rabbit carcass for them to eat? If you have trouble hunting a live rabbit, I have a string of rabbit traps scattered in the woods not far to the east and west of the lodge. I'd appreciate it if you would check the traps and bring back a plump rabbit.
'I'd hate to see mother and cub go without food.'
'This'll do for now, but we can't keep hand-feeding the things, or they'll lose that wild streak that makes them good hunters.'
'Nothing, eh? I'm sure one of the traps is full. Did you check every one?'
Find a rabbit carcass
Bring the rabbit carcass to Thrasi
Hungry Mouths to Feed
Thrasi's lynx and her cub were reunited thanks to your efforts but they are getting hungry, and Thrasi is still nursing his ankle.
'Well, now. They made short work of that rabbit. The mother seems to be recovering.'
'Whoa, nearly lost a finger there!'
'That rabbit made for a fine meal. Pity they didn't leave nary a scrap for me!'

There are traps for small game scattered not far to the east and west of Thrasi's lodge.
Thrasi asked you to either hunt and kill a live rabbit, or to check his traps and bring back a rabbit carcass for the lynx-mother and her cub.
Bring the rabbit carcass to Thrasi at Thrasi's Lodge.
'All right, here you go. Try feeding some of this thistle-mead to the mother lynx. No sneaking sips for yourself, mind you!'

'See? Thistle-mead! Good for what ails you...if you're a cat, that is!
'Hmm. She seems to like me...doesn't want to run off anyway. I could use a hunting partner, and her cub's taken a shine to me as well.
'Thanks for all your help, friend. In a few years, this cub'll be old enough to join me on hunts with his mother. Hendrevail beware!'
The mother lynx sniffs tentatively at the fragrant mead, then quickly laps it all up.
The mother lynx ignores you.
Feed the thistle-mead to the mother lynx
On the Mend
Thrasi has given you some thistle-mead to feed to the mother lynx, hopefully to help heal her injuries.
'That mead should fix her up right!'
'Come back in a few years, and we'll all go hunting with my new friends here.'

The mother lynx is at Thrasi's cabin.
Thrasi asked you to feed the thistle-mead to the mother lynx.

Thrasi is at the hunter's lodge to the north.
The mother lynx seems to be completely healed, yet she has returned to Thrasi's side.
Collected arrowheads (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'Have you come to mock me? Hobbits are the finest archers in all the lands, and there is no one who can tell me different!
'Oh, sorry. I do get a little annoyed with strangers questioning my beliefs. Let me tell you that there were definitely hobbits at the Battle of Fornost. I just need to find proof. Can you help me?
'I need to collect arrowheads from the hobbits that were slain at Fornost. If you could bring me several, that should show those doubters!'

'Wonderful! I knew I was right! You found them! Thank you, thank you, thank you!
'Please take this as a small token of my appreciation!'
'Did you find the arrowheads? There must be small skeletons around everywhere that have the arrowheads on them. Please find them quickly.'
Collect arrowheads (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})
Bring the arrowheads to Bartelot Took
The Forgotten Company

The Tooks in the camp at Fornost are desperately looking for proof that hobbits fought in the Battle of Fornost. They have been ridiculed for their beliefs, so they have come to find the proof they so desperately need.
'Have you found all the arrowheads yet? No, I'll need more than that!'
'This is a wonder, to be sure! There is a truly great Hobbit-friend. All hail, ${PLAYER}!'
'Look, look! The hero of all hobbits everywhere. That ${RACE} proved that hobbits are fierce warriors. I knew it!'

You might find hobbit arrowheads among the skeletons within Fornost, north of the Fornost camp.
Bartelot Took has asked you to collect hobbit arrowheads from the ruins of Fornost, believing that they will prove to everyone that there really were hobbits at the Battle of Fornost.

Bartelot Took is at the Fornost Camp, south of Fornost itself.
Your search produced a large number of arrowheads. You should take them to Bartelot Took.
Defeated trolls (${NUMBER}/${TOTAL})

'Greetings, good ${CLASS}. I see that you, too, are here to watch over Angmar's army and make sure they do not proceed. I need your help, if I may take a moment of your time.
'The evil of Angmar has brought forth more trolls than I had ever wished to lay eyes on. I would hope that your help can be put to use. I no longer wish to see the waste that the trolls have laid on this land. Please rid us of their company.
'These creatures are abominations, undeserving of mercy.'
'You have done us a great service, ${PLAYER}. The lands will breathe easier now that there are fewer trolls to beat upon it.'

Silith is part of Gildor Inglorion's company and was sent to keep an eye on Fornost and the defenders of the Council of Esteldín. He is a good friend to Thaliollang and has brought North his hatred for trolls.
'Thank you again, ${PLAYER}, for your aid against the trolls.'
'Greetings, friend. I am indebted to you for your aid.'

'The horde of Orcs and goblins in this forsaken city make it difficult to maintain our control of this position. Sometimes the raids on our camp seem unceasing, and I do not believe we will hold out long without respite.
'Perhaps it is time to counter their raids with one of our own. Enter the city and slay as many Orcs and goblins as you can. The strongest concentration of their forces seems to be around the foundations of the keep itself.
'If you can deliver a crippling blow to Angmar's army, we may yet survive this siege. Their numbers are great, so you will want to take allies.'
'Well done, ${PLAYER}! You are an inspiration to us all. The Orcs are weakened, and our lines hold. I may have yet another task for you....'
